_comment: Voicible church vocabulary overrides — maps sermon/church-domain gloss words to the nearest available SG ASL Dictionary sign so the LLM's word choice doesn't unnecessarily fall back to fingerspelling. These are STARTING mappings only and MUST be reviewed by a Deaf/ASL consultant before production use (see README, Phase 3). Reconciled 2026-07-03 against the archive's actual indexed signs (see sign_processor/mocap_indexer.py /words); CONGREGATION, BLESSING, and COVENANT were removed because the archive now has real signs for those exact words, making an override unnecessary. BAPTISM/BAPTIZE and COMMUNION/REMEMBER both fall back to fingerspelling either way — the archive has folders for Baptism and Communion but no exported pose JSON for either.
